message: Write down the crazy day I had at Serenity Path. Mark totally lost it during the session, it was so intense. He started yelling out of nowhere, throwing cushions across the room, and even broke a window. It took us a while to calm him down. It's clear that his recent relapse has been really tough on him, and it's affecting his progress in group therapy.
The Hope for Tomorrow Gala was a huge success! We raised more than ever for addiction research. Feeling proud of what we're doing at Serenity Path.
